subject: Request: VM root-cause & fix evidence chain for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Taylor Nguyen <security@keplerbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Bose <anita.bose@keplerbank.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: VM evidence request for upcoming SOC 2 scoping call

Hi Rachel,

Kepler is scoping Redwood for SOC 2 testing next month. Our auditor asked for a concise chain-of-evidence showing:
- recent authenticated network and authenticated agent scans (last 30 days) covering production, staging, and build images
- per-CVE owner, root-cause classification, fix applied, and verification artifact (scan delta or test)
- SLA commitments for critical/important CVEs and any exceptions in the last 12 months

Can you provide a single package (or a short packet of items) that ties each CVE to a remediation action and verification outcome? Ideally: CSV of scan findings, a compact PDF log of remediation entries, and a short runbook describing validation steps.

We need this by COB Tuesday (2027-10-12) so the auditor can include it in the pre-read. If there are any exceptions or pending backfills, please flag them.

Thanks — Taylor
Taylor Nguyen
Senior InfoSec Manager, Kepler Bank
security@keplerbank.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <security@keplerbank.com>
Cc: Anita Bose <anita.bose@keplerbank.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM evidence request for upcoming SOC 2 scoping call

Hi Taylor — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a compact package that maps each CVE to its root cause, remediation owner, action taken, and verification snapshot. Plan: 

1) CSV export of our scanner (production + staging + images) with CVE id, severity, first seen, last seen, owner, status.
2) PDF summary (CVE closure log) with short narrative for each critical/important item and timestamps of remediation and verification run.
3) Remediation runbook (markdown) that describes validation steps we used to confirm fixes (unit tests, canary rollout checks, re-scan ids).

I'll assemble the artifacts and loop in Markus for confirmation of ownership timestamps and Kimberly for the verification attestation. If Kepler's auditor wants any signed attestation language, let us know and we can include a short sign-off page.

Delivering initial packet by Monday EOD PST, final by your Tuesday COB if nothing blocks.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM evidence request for upcoming SOC 2 scoping call

Rachel / Kim — I pulled the relevant closure records from our ticketing and CI system. Quick notes before we send to Kepler: 
- Critical CVE CVE-2027-4312: root cause = third-party dependency (image base). Fix: updated base image + pinned dependency; owner = @monica_patel; remediation completed 2027-10-03; verification scan id: scan-20271004-pt1 (attached).
- Important CVE CVE-2027-3991: root cause = internal config exposing optional debug flag. Fix: config change, canary, and rollback guard; owner = @markus_klein; remediation completed 2027-09-28; verification scanned 2027-09-29.
- Two low items remain pending (low risk, scheduled 2027-11 sprint) — listed in CSV with expected remediation dates.

Attachments I'm adding to the packet: scan-report-20270930.csv (raw), remediation-runbook-20271011.md (procedures + validation commands), and a compact cve-closure-log-20271011.pdf (narratives + timestamps).

Kim, can you confirm attestation language and sign-off line (we usually include: "I attest that the remediation actions and validation records are true and accurate to the best of my knowledge")?

Markus
Engineering Manager, Platform

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM evidence request for upcoming SOC 2 scoping call

On Mon, Oct 11, 2027 at 08:45 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Markus notes attached — confirming the artifacts.

All good from verification side. I reviewed the verification outputs and ran an independent re-scan for the two higher-severity items. Attestation draft below; I can sign it and export to PDF for Kepler: 

"I, Kimberly Park, verify that the remediation actions listed in the attached CVE closure log have been executed and validated against our production and staging environments using the scan IDs and validation steps referenced. Remediation timestamps are recorded from our ticketing system and CI re-scan snapshots are provided as verification artifacts."

I'll produce a one-page attestation.pdf and include it in the packet. Also note: for CVE-2027-4312 we captured the root-cause analysis in the ticket and included the pre- and post-image hashes in the remediation-runbook.

Kimberly Park
Head of Vulnerability Management

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <security@keplerbank.com>
Cc: Anita Bose <anita.bose@keplerbank.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM evidence request for upcoming SOC 2 scoping call

Hi Taylor / Anita — attached is the packet for Kepler's auditor as requested. Summary of contents below and quick callouts: 

Attachments (in zipped packet):
- scan-report-20270930.csv — consolidated findings export (prod, staging, images)
- cve-closure-log-20271011.pdf — per-CVE narratives, owners, timestamps, and verification scan ids
- remediation-runbook-20271011.md — validation steps, commands used, image hashes
- attestation-20271011.pdf — signed verification from Kimberly Park

Callouts:
- All critical items (1) and important items (3) in scope have documented owners and verification scans.
- Two low-severity findings remain with planned fixes in November; they are listed with expected remediation sprint and compensating controls.
- We included a short matrix tying each CVE to a JIRA ticket (JIRA-9521, JIRA-9567, JIRA-9570) and to the scan ID used for verification.

If the auditor needs an explicit signed statement on SLA adherence (e.g., confirming we remediate critical CVEs within 7 days), we can provide a one-paragraph SLA attestation and historical SLA metric extract.

Would you like the packet uploaded to your secure file drop or is the Drive link acceptable?

Thanks — we look forward to the scoping call.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
